name: Progressive Muscle Relaxation Scan

instructions.description: Lie or sit comfortably and notice the natural breath.
Gently tense one muscle group for a brief moment.
Release the tension and notice the contrast.
Continue through several muscle groups without maximal effort.

performanceMetrics.notes: Record the time performed with comfortable, controlled technique.

commentsNotes: Use gentle tension rather than maximal contraction.

variations.variationDescription: Progressive Muscle Relaxation Scan — Shorter Practice Version: Use a shorter comfortable practice period while preserving relaxed breathing.
